notes.title: June update
notes.notes:
Hello everybody.

I have made a few small changes and updated the speech and sound.

A few minor details have also been changed and updates.

I'm currently running a Kickstarter campaign and hopefully it will be successful by the middle of July and then I will start working on the first major update of the game sooner. If you wish to provide me with a extra boost don't hesitate to visit.

Kickstarter

Join me on the Discord channel and share your thoughts about the game.

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!



There is finally a update for the game that I hope will bring you more game time and some new challenges.



Here are some of the updates:

- Two new pieces of artillery

Feldhaubitz 14
British 18-pounder

- Added Loan function 

- I have added some sound to a few locations

- Possibility to skip the tutorial

- There is now a 5-shot series in the shooting range that will give you a average of it's accuracy

- Increased game speed

- Fixed several small bugs
